problem.title: Construct Binary Tree From Preorder and Inorder Traversal

approaches.title: Recursive construction by partitioning preorder and inorder
approaches.summary: Recursively constructs the tree by identifying a root, locating it in inorder, and partitioning the traversals into left and right subtrees. Revision 2 corrects the preorder split so each subtree receives the appropriate elements.

revisions.commitComment: got a hint from solutions about postorder and inorder
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 105: got a hint from solutions about postorder and inorder
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial recursive attempt searches for a matching preorder/inorder value and partitions the inorder traversal. It incorrectly gives both recursive calls the same preorder suffix rather than splitting preorder according to the left subtree size.
Uses the first preorder element as the root, finds its inorder position, and correctly splits the remaining preorder values into left and right subtree ranges.
